svg.title: pleuromeia-ebro-253394 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original generalized unbranched lycopsid stem with basal lobes, drooping leaves and a terminal cone, not a measured Ebro Basin specimen or a diagnostic P. sternbergii reconstruction. The Induan age envelope does not date this plant exactly to 251 Ma or establish continuous existence.
